Prima & Timo — Album 7: Quattuor

Stoney Family

"Reunited in the stone"

[Rocky outskirts + distant reunion sounds] [Verse 1] The crew reached the outskirts, a vast rocky plain in view Thousands of stone creatures scattered, waiting in the blue Stoney’s eyes lit up, rumbling with joy and tears His family was here… after all these years

They ran to each other, a massive stony embrace Questions flying, stories shared in that ancient place “We were suddenly here… a flash and then this door No memory of how… or what we came here for” [Pre-Chorus] Stoney introduced the crew, pride in his rocky tone The stone people welcomed them, no longer alone [Chorus — emotional & wondrous] Stoney Family Reunited in the stone Stoney Family No longer lost and alone A door stands waiting, inscription none can read But something calls to Prima… planting a seed [Verse 2] They sat together, sharing a simple stony meal Laughter rumbling deep, the wounds beginning to heal Sofia looked at the door, ancient knowledge in her gaze “I can read it, loves… it says this door opens for a true core’s blaze”

Preema approached slowly, her upgrades humming loud A voice from deep inside her core spoke soft and proud “Welcome child… the half that is incomplete Step in and begin… your journey to find the truth you seek” [Pre-Chorus 2] The crew stood up together, hearts full of resolve Ready for whatever waited… beyond the door’s dissolve [Chorus — emotional & wondrous] Stoney Family Reunited in the stone Stoney Family No longer lost and alone A door stands waiting, inscription none can read But something calls to Preema… planting a seed [Bridge — determined] Preema turned to the team, voice steady and true “Onward we go… to find the truth.” [Solo]

[Coda] We were about to go through the door and start anew Then we hear a familiar hum a sound we thought we lost We turn around and see a roboduster looking shiny and new Upgraded parts fitted in to replace the familiar and old

He started moving towards the surprised crew He cleaned away as he approached keeping his gaze He looked at Preema, Vendo and was a bit confused A Frog? and another creature he does not recognize

They were standing in front of Preema Waiting - Holding - [Pre-Chorus 2] I am not sure if you recognize me with my new body But I know who you are, you are alive -

Ronnie [Key lift][Note lift] [Chorus — emotional & wondrous] Ronnie the Roboduster We are glad to see you are alive Ronnie the Roboduster So happy to see you have suvived The lights, the chase, the fear we felt that day Seeing you here, washes all the tears away [Outro — powerful cliffhanger] Ronnie looked at them without speaking

Preema can hear his core humming

Vendo approached and offered a blue banana

Bernard ready to unleash his Ninja moves

Sofia was frozen, but was ready to go

Then suddenly –
